description: Replays with a patched radard (copy of the pinned openpilot; unchanged planner) against fused 2.4 with the stock radard: where the ARS510's extra information could be used outside the interface. 27 replay drives (counts as in docs/09) and the road drives against the hindsight-lead oracle (oracle_reference.json). Extra per-point values reached radard through RadarPoint's deprecated fields (replay only).

variants.radar_arel: aLeadK = ego acceleration + the ACC target's relative acceleration (0x235 byte 2) for the ACC target's track; radard's filter otherwise
variants.vision_fusion: radard fuses the vision lead's speed into the matched radar track (sigma 2 x model vStd), fixed radar variance; interface = fused 2.4
variants.pass_through: interface without its speed filter or range fusion (ACC target's values for its track, raw object list otherwise, age 60, path gate, saturation guard); radard fuses vision and weights each radar reading by max(1, sigma^2), sigma = 0.045 x 240|7 (young-scaled) or 0.5 for the ACC target

radar_arel.note: a newly acquired ACC target's relative acceleration starts near zero and replaces the deceleration radard's filter had built up: one added 2.4 s miss (oracle -3.5 m/s2, variant -0.49) and a far real closing answered later

reading: the per-point weighting does not move into radard as a variance: radard's [vLead, aLead] filter, tuned for responsive radars, cannot stand in for the interface's low-process-noise speed filter; the radar's relative acceleration needs a hand-over rule for new targets before radard could use it
